edit.old: - A relative time word such as 目前 or 现在 is a time node attached as `(document-creation-time :depends-on <node>)`. Do not attach it to `present-reference`. Then chain the events from it with `:overlap`.
edit.new: - A relative time word such as 目前 or 现在 is a `:temporal` node in the graph but gets **no** temporal parent of its own. Link the main event of its clause to `document-creation-time` with `:depends-on` (`(document-creation-time :depends-on <main event>)`), then chain the other events from that main ev...
(*nowadays*) on `past-reference` / `present-reference` / `future-reference` (for 目前/现在 see the rule below).

edit.old: 已经 + 停止 or another end verb used to describe an entity is `state` (the resulting state).
edit.new: 已经 + 停止 or another end verb is `state` only inside a relative clause that describes an entity (已经停止发行的小报); as the main predicate, 已经 + an end verb (已经停刊) is `performance`.

edit.anchor: - Within one sentence, coreference is a re-entrancy in the graph (one variable), not a `:coref` triple.
edit.text: - Link two mentions only when they pick out the same individual or the same single event. Do not link two mentions of the same verb with different arguments, times or polarity (发行 of the print edition vs 发行 of the online edition). Do not link noun phrases with the same head but different restrictor...

edit.anchor: - Every event the author asserts: `(author :full-affirmative s1e)`.
edit.text: - The root abstract predicate (`identity-91`, `have-mod-91`, ...) of an asserted sentence also gets `(author :full-affirmative …)`, although it gets no temporal parent.

edit.anchor: - Do not add arguments (agents, possessors) that the text does not express or clearly imply.
edit.text:
Do not fill the subject of a later clause with an entity from an earlier clause (…，不过仍继续发行网络版: 发行 has no `:ARG0`).
- An edition, version or part of a publication or organization (纸本, 网络版, 分部) takes `:part-of` its whole, not `:possessor`.
- For an intransitive Chinese verb not in PropBank (停刊, 停业), ...
Keep compound verbs whole (称为 → `称为-01`, not `称-01`).
`have-degree-91` gets no `:aspect`. A frame such as 历史上 / 在…上 is `:temporal (上 :op1 (历史))` on the noun, not an `:ARG4` of `have-degree-91`.

edit.old: - Temporal chain (5.1): 目前…发行…网络版 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x) (s4x :overlap s4x2) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6)`. The other events of a sentence hang from its main event: `(document-creation-time :before s1x3) (s1x3 :overlap s1x4)`.
edit.new:
- Temporal chain (5.1): 目前…停刊，不过仍继续发行网络版 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x 停刊) (s4x :overlap s4x2 继续) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6 发行)`; 目前 has no temporal parent.
- Copular root (5.1): 是…已经停止发行的小报，以报导…而闻名 → `(document-creation-time :before 发行) (发行 :overlap 停止) (闻名 :contained 发行) (发行 :overlap 报导)`; ...
